phrases.title: Unfurling
phrases.note: A two-floor lift and a bucket wheel turn the opening back on itself.

phrases.title: First wave
phrases.note: Drop below the opening, launch upward, then let a suspended carry breathe.

phrases.title: Weight and suspension
phrases.note: A relay and a weight answer the melody; spiral down, float back up, change color.

phrases.title: Lift and return
phrases.note: Swing over open space, fall back underneath, then recover one floor.

phrases.title: Bright crest
phrases.note: A spring and pendulum gather pace before another deep reversal.

phrases.title: Quiet rebuilding
phrases.note: A screw, bridge and conveyor turn the softer passage into patient work.

phrases.title: Answer in flights
phrases.note: Bounce, flick, tip and hand off, folding under the previous terraces.

phrases.title: Suspended line
phrases.note: A long carry passes into gears and a seesaw; the cage lifts the answer.

phrases.title: Opening into forest
phrases.note: A ceiling ride and spiral descend into a broad final swing; leave at the quiet cadence.

phrases.title: Growth resumes
phrases.note: Grow two floors, tip back, then descend in a well beside the first climb.

phrases.title: The singing path
phrases.note: A spade launches the line; a snail takes its time, and an apple inherits the motion.

phrases.title: A leaf answers
phrases.note: One mallet accent, a drifting leaf, and a quiet barrow beneath the path.

phrases.title: Seed in the air
phrases.note: Mushrooms lift the ball; the dandelion reverses into a flower spiral.

phrases.title: Over the old route
phrases.note: A bee and a seed rise above the earlier terraces, pass a gate, and turn east on a vine.

phrases.title: The quieter terrace
phrases.note: Carry, launch, drop through a burrow, and wait for the cocoon.

phrases.title: Forest crest
phrases.note: Bounce and drop through the crest; a frog folds the route back.

phrases.title: A higher answer
phrases.note: Float above the frog, release a pod, fall with a leaf, and slow at the gate.

phrases.title: Back through the roots
phrases.note: Spiral down and travel west beneath the high path, leaving through the roots.

phrases.title: A light on the water
phrases.note: The lighthouse and dolphin rise; an anchor takes the chain below the pier.

phrases.title: Across the tide
phrases.note: Sail back underneath, drop again, hand off a pearl, and rise through kelp.

phrases.title: The large wave
phrases.note: A pouch carry, whale spout and floats lead into a whirlpool reversal.

phrases.title: The wave recedes
phrases.note: The anemone changes the ball, then a descent and a suspended line slow the motion.

phrases.title: Almost still
phrases.note: Small rocking and a held balance leave air in the quietest passage.

phrases.title: A distant return
phrases.note: The light returns; a jellyfish and dinghy cross above the previous route.

phrases.title: Leaving the water
phrases.note: A final pearl transfer and whirlpool turn carry the route into the quiet transition.

phrases.title: Lights wake
phrases.note: A claw and slow wheel lift the returning melody; the shooter rises above them.

phrases.title: The returning line
phrases.note: A hoop, lever and bumper give accents before a beam lift and ghost passage.

phrases.title: Crest above the midway
phrases.note: The striker turns west; a relay fires into a coaster, then a beam lifts back east.

phrases.title: A gentler wheel
phrases.note: Wheel and claw carry the retreat, then the lever and tubes descend.

phrases.title: Gathering again
phrases.note: Moles, a sling and a mallet build the next answer before the cleared line turns west.

phrases.title: Through the lit terraces
phrases.note: A token transfer, ghost passage and two different coaster approaches fold down through the map.

phrases.title: The line opens out
phrases.note: A suspended carry and wheel slow the line as it reaches the lower terraces.

phrases.title: Coda, with space
phrases.note: Descend, rise on the wheel, wait in the claw, and let the lever settle.

phrases.title: A last rising answer
phrases.note: The last answer climbs in stages, with short accents between the lifts.

phrases.title: The final arc
phrases.note: A slow wheel and a last token transfer lead to a gentle carry.

phrases.title: Release and resonance
phrases.note: A final beam lift folds back onto one cell of rail; the ball stops while the piano resonance fades.
